notes.title: 🐞 Bug Fixes – The Darkblade Patch 2025-07-25
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers,

Today’s patch focuses on fixing a major crash and improving one of the upgrade UX issues:

🛠️ Bug Fix: Force Close with Indonesian Language

Fixed a crash that occurred when playing with Bahasa Indonesia selected

The game should now run smoothly in Indonesian — no more sudden force closes during gameplay or menus

Terima kasih for your patience!

✨ Upgrade Menu Closing Enhancement

Improved the behavior when closing the Core Upgrade UI/Enhancement

No more awkward transitions or UI glitches after upgrading — it now feels smoother and more responsive

Im continuing to polish the game and squash bugs — thanks to everyone reporting issues and helping me make The Darkblade a better experience.

notes.title: 🎮 Controller Update – D-Pad Movement Support + Menu Fix
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers,

We’ve got a small but meaningful update for all the controller players out there!

✅ New: D-Pad Support for Movement
You can now use the D-Pad to move your character — not just the analog stick!

Ideal for precision movement in tight spaces

Great for those who prefer classic directional input

🛠️ Bug Fix: Load Game Dialog Not Closing

Fixed an issue where the Load Game dialog wouldn’t close after selecting a save file from the main menu (when using controller)

Thanks again to everyone who reported these issues and shared suggestions — your feedback directly improves The Darkblade every step of the way.

notes.title: 🐞 Bug Fixes – The Darkblade Patch 2025-06-20
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers,

Here’s a quick patch focused on cleaning up some lingering issues — thanks to all the sharp-eyed players who pointed them out!

🛠️ Bug Fixes:

🗣️ Fixed awkward phrasing “Wise, Indeed...” into  “Wise?” in the final dialogue with the samurai

🌲 Corrected duplicate text “Oak ForestForest”

🌍 Fixed glitchy ground in Oak Forest area

🧙‍♀️ Adjusted dialogue between Eleonore and Joanna in Night City — they now correctly refer to L as "he" instead of "you"

💎 Fixed not working Core Upgrades 

These fixes are all part of making The Darkblade world feel more polished and immersive.

Got something odd happening in your playthrough? Let us know! And as always, wishlist the full game and help spread the word!

notes.title: 🖥️ Update – Fullscreen Now Works with Any Resolution
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers,

We’ve rolled out a small but important update to improve fullscreen support:

✅ Fullscreen Now Works with Any Resolution
You can now switch to fullscreen using any resolution available in the settings — no restrictions.

❗Note: If your selected resolution doesn’t match your monitor’s aspect ratio, the game will display with black bars to maintain proper scaling and avoid distortion. This ensures the pixel art and gameplay look crisp and consistent across all setups.

Thanks as always for your feedback — keep it coming! And if you haven’t already, wishlist The Darkblade on Steam and help spread the word!

notes.title: 🛠️ Update – New Setting: HUD Distance Adjustment
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers,

We’ve added a small but handy new setting to give you more control over your UI experience:

✅ New: HUD Distance Setting

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/41ab23ef2f79ede447307f47deaeb598aeccc27d.png"]
Now you can adjust how close or far the HUD appears from screen edges.

Prefer a tighter UI for fast reflexes? Pull it in.

Want breathing room on an ultrawide setup? Space it out.

Works great alongside the UI Scale setting!

This should help players fine-tune their experience based on screen size, personal comfort, or aesthetic preference.

🧠 Little changes like this go a long way — and they’re only possible thanks to your feedback.

As always, wishlist The Darkblade if you haven’t already and let us know what settings or tweaks you’d love next!

notes.title: 🩸 Major Update – Health Points Added in Casual Mode!
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers,

We’ve been listening closely to your feedback — and one thing came through loud and clear:

“Casual Mode is still brutally hard.”

📊 Based on feedback from over 80% of players, we’re making a major update to improve the experience:


[hr][/hr]✅ Health Points Added to Casual Mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/14ec8e53e39135556f1f8ebaf0c545094105f8f3.png"]

Casual Mode now features its own HP system:

You can take multiple hits without dying instantly

Makes the game more forgiving and exploration-friendly

Great for players who want to focus on the story and atmosphere

❗Note: Now you will NOT receive any defense % buffs.


[hr][/hr]🖥️ New: UI Scale Settings
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622115/ab39fef9db86e58dcb35ab4be6a04dd4b137e25e.png"]

You can now adjust the UI size from the settings menu!

Useful for different screen sizes or personal preference

Especially helpful on large displays


[hr][/hr]
💬 Keep the Feedback Coming!
This game is built with your input. We're committed to making The Darkblade challenging but fair — and fun for everyone.

If you haven’t already, wishlist the game on Steam and help spread the word!
